**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BuildOwner.java`** (lines 13-19)
```java
public void service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerMapper ownerMapper, Out<Owner> built) {
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(request);
    if (owner.getRegistrationDate() == null) {
        owner.setRegistrationDate(LocalDate.now());   // line 16
    }
    built.set(owner);
}
```
If the request supplies `registrationDate` it is preserved (mapped through `OwnerMapper.toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)`); otherwise it defaults to `LocalDate.now()`.

Note a likely gap: the OpenAPI/DTO spec and the acceptance test expect the default to fall on a **business day** (weekend rolls forward to Monday), but `BuildOwner` uses a plain `LocalDate.now()` with no weekend roll-forward. See the test in section 6.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** (line 23):
```java
@Mapping(target = "membershipNumber", expression = "java(owner.getCustomerCode() == null || owner.getRegistrationDate() == null ? null : owner.getCustomerCode() + \"-M\" + String.format(\"%02d\", owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100))")

Format: `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, where `YY` is the last two digits of the **registrationDate year** (`getYear() % 100`, zero-padded to 2 digits). Returns `null` if either `customerCode` or `registrationDate` is null. This is the direct link between registration date and membership number.

The `customerCode` it builds on is assigned in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`** (line 28): format `%s-%s-%04d` → `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (per-city sequence).     for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {     // line 26
